verdict.rationale: Stripe's platform (which Terminal transactions flow through) exposes payouts and balance data via API (docs-39), webhooks for event-driven sync (docs-38), and an official MCP server letting AI agents call the Stripe API (docs-35), giving the building blocks for an agent to pull transactions/payouts and reconcile them. However, there's no Terminal-specific reconciliation or ledger feature, and no evidence of a purpose-built agent workflow for daily reconciliation, so support is generic/indirect rather than a dedicated capability.
